infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RaktaSetu needs your location to display nearby blood donation requests.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: RaktaSetu needs background location access to alert you when emergency blood requests occur near you during an active sharing session.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RaktaSetu to access your location in the background during an active, explicit donation session.
plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Allow RaktaSetu to access your location while using the app.
